{{Quote|A plasma bomb? That could level an entire quadrant of Curamelle.|Noro Zak|<ref name="Jedi Emergency" />}}
'''Plasma bombs''' were a type of explosive [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] weapons in use during multiple periods of history, especially during the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The ordnance was constructed for a time in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]]. They were used by [[Bartokk]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] in an attempt to destroy the [[Corulag Academy]]. Later, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] used plasma bombs on [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]]; the bombs were set off as a diversion during the [[Battle of the Sixela system]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. By [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the [[Scohar Xenohealth Institute]] had acquired a plasma bomb as a precaution against a contagion outbreak.

==History==
===Before the Republic===
Plasma bombs were among the ordnance constructed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nox (planet)|Nox]], in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]]. They were used by the dome [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Knool Tandor]] during the [[tragedy of Greenwood Station]].<ref name="Void" />

===Galactic Republic===
When, due to the separate efforts of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], the [[Bartokk]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] hired by [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] failed to destroy the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Corulag Academy|Academy]] on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] using stolen [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]], the [[Bartokk Queen]] decided to fulfill her contract with Groodo by using a subtler strategy. To this end, the Bartokks were sent to [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], where they stole a [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|space yacht]] and six [[X10-D draft droid]]s. Three of the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] had compact remote-cotrolled proton bombs installed into their torsos, each of the explosives shaped like geodesic spheres and carrying enough firepower to level a small city (or a quadrant of a city the size of [[Curamelle/Legends|Curamelle]]). The Bartokks planned to infiltrate the bomb-equipped droids among the other draft droids into the Academy [[Science Service]] tower and then trigger the bombs, causing the destruction of the Corulag Academy. However, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] succeeded in deactivating all the draft droids and, with the help of a [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]], deactivated two of the bombs while exploding the third bomb aboard the Bartokks' space [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] at a safe altitude in Corulag's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].<ref name="Jedi Emergency" />

===Early Galactic Civil War===
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]] [[Battle of the Sixela system|released]] their plasma bombs to create a cloud of ionized gases a [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] across. The cloud interfered with electronic systems. Rebel [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Lune Oddo Divinian|Div]] were pursued by a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] through the cloud; the Rebels maneuvered downward at Div's command, letting the TIEs hit an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] hidden by the cloud, causing serious damage to the [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="RF:Uprising" />

===Zsinj campaign===
The [[Scohar Xenohealth Institute]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Storinal]] held a plasma bomb around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. It the event of a contagion outbreak in the disease containment vault, the bomb would have gone off and incinerated the entire building. The Institute was [[Mission to Storinal|infiltrated]] by the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing unit]] [[Wraith Squadron]] to steal a sample of [[Bunkurd Sewer Disorder]] for use in [[Hunt for Zsinj|their campaign against]] the [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]. The Wraiths succeeded in stealing the sample and exfiltrated without setting off the plasma bomb.<ref name="Wraith Squadron" />

==Behind the scenes==
These weapons first appeared in [[Aaron Allston]]'s [[1998]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''. They appeared the following [[1999|year]], and again in [[2010]] with [[Alex Wheeler]]'s ''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''. In [[2013]], plasma bombs were featured in the pre-Republic story ''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''.
